2390-3966-7289.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-7289.description:
Gain life.
Leonardo triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

687-3862-4613-5231-8130.description:
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target and creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Orcish Bowmasters and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Orcish Bowmasters from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-3862-4613-5231-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

3966-6033-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3966-6033-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

728-5276-5332-6524.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

728-6528-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7379.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7379.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-4885-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-4885-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

112-757-5087-5524.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
112-757-5087-5524.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Clockspinning to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Destiny Spinner, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

431-851-4365-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-4365-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

489-2146-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-4478-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4478-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-7332.description:
Activate Casey & Raph by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Casey & Raph enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Casey & Raph.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
1409-7332.notes: You can optionally have an opponent exile the top card of their library in step 3 using Casey & Raph's other mode. This does allow them to cast it for free, which may allow them access to pieces that will disrupt the combo (such as a removal spell).

1006-7124.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
1006-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate The Incredible Hulk by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to it.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4352-5686-6972--112.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
4352-5686-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

3180-5660-5684.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Chamber Sentry from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6556-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1497-5220-6634-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

856-5147-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-5147-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-5147-5220-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4267-4996-6900.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 6 or higher.
You have another card in hand.
4267-4996-6900.description:
Activate Divining Witch by paying {1}{B}, tapping it and discarding a card except for Beacon of Immortality, naming a card not in your library and exiling your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Repeat step 3.

4131-5541-6923.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}. Relic Putrescence triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 eight additional times, and then repeat step 1 once. This will result in a total of ten Relic Putrescence triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, donating Basalt Monolith to an opponent.
Resolve all Relic Putrescence triggers, causing the opponent who controls it to get ten poison counters. They will then lose the game as a state-based action.

413-628-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-628-6863--133.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
When the Dinosaur enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-628-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

3609-5921-6750.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
3609-5921-6750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers twice, putting four charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

147-5147-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-5147-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

372-465-4200.notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Wormfang Drake
372-465-4200.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wormfang Drake.
Wormfang Drake leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering Wormfang Drake's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Wormfang Drake trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger from step 5, exiling Abdel Adrian until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

955-2457-4094-4289.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
955-2457-4094-4289.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

3951-3967-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-3967-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

225-565-1987-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-5913.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Pinnacle Monk.
When the land and Pinnacle Monk enter the battlefield, Pinnacle Monk and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-5913.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

282-1339-2034-5185.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-1339-2034-5185.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one nonlegendary token copy of The Locust God.
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God and the Locust God token each trigger twice, creating a total of four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat from step 3.

307-2306-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Prosperous Thief and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Prosperous Thief or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}.
307-2306-3542.description:
Declare Palinchron and Prosperous Thief as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Prosperous Thief from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Prosperous Thief's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Prosperous Thief onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1256-2092-4214.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
1256-2092-4214.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Utopia Mycon's first ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {G}.
Repeat.

628-2781-3305-4050.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2781-3305-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding one mana of any color.
When Felidar Guardian dies, its undying ability and Body Launderer's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Launderer.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding one mana of any color.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger from step 5, blinking Body Launderer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding one mana of any color.
When Body Launderer dies, its undying and second ability triggers.
Resolve the undying trigger,  returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Body Launderer trigger, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any other permanent you control.
Repeat.

703-2751-2855-2972.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger, along with Dragon Tempest's first and second abilities.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's ability, targeting Strionic Resonator.
Resolve the copy of Astral Dragon's ability, creating two token copies of Strionic Resonator that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
When the Strionic Resonator tokens enter the battlefield, Ganax's ability, as well as Dragon Tempest's first and second abilities, trigger twice each.
Resolve both Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Resolve both of Dragon Tempest's first ability triggers, giving the Strionic Resonator tokens haste until end of turn.
Resolve both of Dragon Tempest's second ability triggers, dealing damage equal to the Strionic Resonator tokens' power to any target.
Activate a Strionic Resonator copy by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 6.

2034-2523-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken legendary creature.
2034-2523-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Ratadrabik and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of the creature that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, returning the legendary creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

900-1550-2239-3827.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home and Sword of Feast and Famine attached to any other creature without summoning sickness.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R/W}{R/W}.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with the Swords attached.
900-1550-2239-3827.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home and Sword of Feast and Famine trigger.
Resolve the Sword of Hearth and Home trigger, blinking Ardent Elementalist and causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield.
Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, returning Waves of Aggression from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sword of Feast and Famine trigger, causing you to untap all lands you control, and causing the defending player to discard a card.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R/W}{R/W}.
Cast Waves of Aggression by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
 Repeat.

uses.n: Hanweir Militia Captain // Westvale Cult Leader

1450-2067-3858.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures you control is equal to or greater than nineteen.
1450-2067-3858.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, as well as Hanweir Militia Captain if it isn't transformed.
Resolve the Hanweir Militia Captain trigger, if applicable, causing it to transform.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

2000-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2000-2034-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Gixian Infiltrator, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

186-1409-2690-4208-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Deadeye Navigator.
The Deadeye Navigator token enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability, pairing it and Ixidron.
Activate Ixidron by paying {U}, blinking it.
All other nontoken creatures you control are turned face-down as Ixidron enters the battlefield.
Ixidron enters the battlefield, triggering the token Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing Ixidron and the token Deadeye Navigator.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {1}, turning it face up.
Rattleclaw Mystic triggers, adding {G}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

170-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
170-2034-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Woodland Champion.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Woodland Champion trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3175-4050-4681-4812.description:
Cast Sun Titan.
Sun Titan enters the battlefield, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
With the Animate Dead trigger on the stack, Activate Phyrexian Altar, sacrificing Sun Titan to add a mana of any color.
Resolve the Animate Dead trigger, causing it to become an Aura with "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Animate Dead" and returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Animate Dead is put into your graveyard due to state based actions, as it cannot attach to a creature with protection from black.
Animate Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide's enter the battlefield triggers.
Resolve Karmic Guide's enter the battlefield trigger returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

457-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Urza, adding {C}{C}.
When Urza dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Urza from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Urza enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
457-2034-5003.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.
You can also tap the Construct for {U} due to Urza's ability, netting mana and allowing you to not sacrifice the Constructs eventually.

614-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
614-1987-3075.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Nucklavee and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
